data.name: Ayon
data.gender_notes: Ayon is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayon is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'ay' meaning 'life' or 'breath'. It is a significant name in Hindu mythology, representing the vital force that sustains all living beings. The name Ayon carries the meaning “Breath, Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayon usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ayon belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breath, Life.”

According to mythology, Ayon represents the primordial energy that sustains all of creation. In India, it is common to name children with meaningful and auspicious names like Ayon, as they are believed to bring blessings and positivity into their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Ayon symbolizes the life force or Prana that is present in every living being. It is a reminder of the essential role that the breath plays in sustaining life and the interconnectedness of all things. In Hindu traditions, the name Ayon is chanted to invoke the divine energy of the universe and to connect with the source of all existence.
